scientific_question: Does identity-free amine-semantic conditioning move exact-L1 precursor-role morphology closer to the group-balanced measured Ugi train-development reference than the paired count-only program, despite its failed global C2ST and validity gates?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only development re-adjudication, not a held-out or across-training-seed model claim.
The assay performs no training, generation, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
The panel reports directional consistency without a confidence interval or significance claim.
C2ST is a secondary diagnostic and does not determine the panel classification.
A role-panel improvement cannot override a failed validity or exact-L1 non-inferiority gate.
